items.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I’m currently involved in a very interesting project with a synthesist and a recording studio guy named Pat Gleason... So to me makes sense to collaborate with someone like that.

ctx.x: I know you went through a few years or a period where you were doing some prepared piano music. © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-

Um hum. There actually was a whole decade that I was immersed in a kind of a multiple keyboard integration of classical, rock, jazz, funk and electronic music. It started in the late 60s, around ’67, ’68. Well before there were any kind of polyphonic synthesizers around or even portable monophonic ones. It was maybe just as the ARP 2600 was coming out.
